segments.head: /* @module wclm/operators/bind
segments.label: the module's claim
segments.does: Forms light the meanings whose labels they cover. The formula is stated where it can be edited — and has been, once, by the founder: that IS the training loop.

segments.head: 'use strict';
segments.label: strict mode + one helper
segments.does: r3 from the engine: every stated formula reports through 3-decimal rounding so replays compare byte-identical.

segments.head: export const block = {
segments.label: the pipeline contract
segments.does: Core; reads stream, writes bindings. Falls back gracefully: profiles when attend ran, the content stream otherwise.

segments.head: run(s, world) {
segments.label: who counts as present
segments.does: Builds the evidence set: content tokens (known, non-padding, non-operator); src is the attention profiles when they exist, else the content stream minus foreign words; keep() drops negated forms unless carryAll made the marks advisory. present is the Set of forms allowed to light meanings.

vars.content: the content tokens, foreign included (for the withdrawal audit)
vars.src: profiles or filtered stream — the evidence source
vars.s.negated: the withdrawn-by-negation list converge will check

segments.head: s.foreign = [];
segments.label: one withdrawal per word
segments.does: Collects the sense-switched words — ONE entry per word however often it is said (the duplicated-note bug the founder's screenshot caught, fixed here) — carrying the sense's label, domain and definition for the sense binding and converge's warning. Empty in advisory mode.

segments.head: const pulled = new Set(s.attention ? s.attention.profiles.flatMap((p) => p.pulls.map((x) => x.form)) : []);
segments.label: the stated formula
segments.does: bind = half label coverage + half prompt coverage + 0.1 per label form that attention PULLED into range. Coverages are evidence; the halves and the bonus are opinion. Returns null when nothing lights — a non-binding is not a zero-scoring binding.

vars.score(forms): the formula, or null when no direct coverage

segments.head: s.bindings = [];
segments.label: lighting the three surfaces
segments.does: Scores every document concept and every pack term whose label overlaps present, recording via — the exact forms that lit it. Then each foreign word binds its CHOSEN sense instead: the word fully covers the sense's label, over the prompt's content forms. Sorted by score, ties by id, so replay is stable.

vars.s.bindings: [{id, kind: doc|pack|sense, label, score, via, ...}] ranked
